name: 058.1 — the unit at the widget boundary
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 058.1: every number hafen.ui takes or gives for a coordinate or a size is a design pixel. It writes a size and a position on a surface, a control and the client's own widgets and reads back the very pair it wrote; it proves the pointer, the hit test and the layout box are one space; and it prints the running UI scale beside a bare button's height, which is the same integer at every scale. Declares no permissions and restores everything it touches.
